ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity white/cream pixels in the central regions versus 25% low-intensity black pixels localized along the perimeter and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit contiguous high-intensity white fields with diffuse yellowish-brown mottling. Peripheral margins are defined by thick, irregular black bands with inward-projecting linear streaks, particularly on the inner trailing edges near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees; depth extends approximately 15% into the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by jagged peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary, most pronounced on the distal lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading toward the median notch, transitioning to a convex outward trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant cluster of high-contrast, raised calcified pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the far left tip. A distinct, dark circular focal point is present in the mid-section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible, notably a prominent horizontal mark on the mid-right lobe and several vertical streaks near the right trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the left fluke tip; distinct circular scar on the left lobe; multiple linear rake marks across the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown pixel staining (likely diatoms) distributed across the primary white surfaces of both lobes.
